name: Fib Finder
hook: Write a fake answer. Spot the real one.
how: A strange true fact appears with a word missing. Everyone writes a fake answer, then all the fakes and the truth are shown together: find the real one, and score again for everyone your fake fools.
controls: Type your fake and press Enter; click or tap an answer to vote (or press 1–9)
uses: Your fake is sealed so only the host can read it until the vote (the host builds the answer list).
The host's browser runs the timers, builds the answer list and scores every vote; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots write fakes and vote until enough people join.
Each player's best game, in points.
ideas: Make a question pack about movies
Make the last round worth double points
Add a vote for the funniest fake
